items.reason: Requirement boundaries still changed in the final configured audit round.

unresolved_candidate.description: Booking functionality is said to be already under consideration, but the supplied evidence does not define its behavior well enough to establish an independent early booking Requirement beyond the later Get a Quote page and CTA destination.

The agency claims general desktop, tablet, and mobile responsiveness, but client evidence only establishes specific mobile pricing and hover decisions. It is unclear whether a separate sitewide responsiveness Requirement is warranted.
